editorial.blurb: Dollop Diner is a bright, welcoming spot for breakfast and brunch where expertly crafted coffee and creative comfort food—like crispy Chilaquiles and buttery chicken biscuits—keep locals and visitors coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Come before a Cubs game for brunch; the chicken biscuit is a standout, and they stock Beacon Donuts (all vegan) if you want to take something sweet with you.
